property_summary: After any call to the fallback function with exactly 10 ether and a future timestamp, the contract's balance should only change (i.e. drop to zero) when block.number is a multiple of 15; otherwise, the balance strictly increases. The bug violates this by always transferring the entire balance, causing a drain even when block.number % 15 != 0.
change_summary: Remove the entire if-condition so the balance is transferred unconditionally after updating pastBlockTime.
